name: Encrypted Memorandum
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Sten Stoutarm gives new gnome rogues a folded note for Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar.

sections.title: A Discreet Introduction
sections.body: As you help the mountaineers face trogg threats, Sten gives you a parchment entrusted to him. It looks like an official memorandum. The note invites you to meet Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer stationed inside Anvilmar.

sections.title: Shared Hardships in the Snow
sections.body: Gnome survivors share close quarters with their dwarven hosts after Gnomeregan's sudden fall drove them from their underground home. Solm Hargrin knows rogues draw suspicion when items go missing. So he urges them to stand together quietly and help each other survive.

faq.answer: Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer inside Anvilmar, wrote the note. He disguised it as an official directive from higher-ups so Sten Stoutarm would pass it on without suspicion.

Solm Hargrin disguises the note to approach you discreetly in Anvilmar, a dwarven hold. He keeps a low profile to avoid rumors or accusations when gear goes missing, and uses coded greetings to reach fellow scoundrels.

faq.q: What does this note reveal about the situation in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: The note describes the strain and solidarity between gnomes and dwarves after Gnomeregan's loss. Sharing space in Ironforge and Dun Morogh strains resources, so Solm urges those in the shadow trade to look out for one another.

faq.q: Who delivers the memorandum to the player?
faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm hands you the memorandum after you help him in Coldridge Valley. He assumes Solm Hargrin sent it for your training.

faq.q: What role does Solm Hargrin serve?
faq.answer: Solm Hargrin trains rogues inside Anvilmar's mountain hall. He teaches new rogues combat techniques and shadowy talents.

faq.q: Does this quest relate to Gnomeregan's fall?
faq.answer: Yes. Solm speaks of Gnomeregan being overrun and says displaced gnomish rogues can endure through their shared brotherhood, despite losing their mechanical homeland.

angles.text: As a rogue, you receive your first call to meet Solm Hargrin. His message introduces the mutual protection needed to practice your covert trade in dwarven lands.
As a gnome, you see the hardship facing refugees after Gnomeregan's fall. Its survivors band together as guests among the dwarves.
As a dwarf, you see mountaineers like Sten Stoutarm carry messages between Ironforge and the displaced gnomes in Coldridge Valley.
